games.name: Hike For Eggs
games.desc:
🥾 Welcome to Hike for Eggs!

How to Play:
🏔️ Hike up the mountain trail to find animal nests
🥚 Steal eggs from sleeping animal parents
🏃 Run back to base before the parent catches you!
🐣 Hatch eggs in your pen to collect over 100 animal types!
💰 Earn money from your pets
💪 Train Strength to climb faster and outrun bigger parents
🥢 Buy better hiking poles to train Strength faster
🏕️ Build ranger camps and send rangers to fetch eggs for you
✨ Climb 18 stages, from a Goat in the Foothills to a Dragon on Genesis Summit, and discover rarer eggs, pets, sizes, and mutations!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players

games.desc:
Saddle up your dream horse and explore vast islands where wild horses roam free! Capture them to build your ultimate collection and expand your stables! 🐎

❤️ Bond with your horse by taking care of their needs and spending time together
🤝 Trade, socialize, and roleplay with friends

games.name: Riot City 🚨 Prison Escape
games.desc:
Welcome to Riot City! Escape prison, become a criminal, rob the bank, collect cars and guns, or enforce the law as a cop and arrest criminals!

👮‍♂️ Riot City is the ultimate cops vs prisoners experience on Roblox. Jump into a massive open-world city where every session is a battle between chaos and justice. Start as a prisoner, break out, build your criminal empire, pull off robberies, escape high-speed police chases, and dominate the streets. Or join the police force, gear up, hunt down dangerous criminals, shut down heists, and restore order across the city. With 20+ vehicles and 15+ guns to collect, Riot City is packed with action, progression, and deep customization. Build your perfect ride with vehicle upgrades and customization options, expand your arsenal, and battle on either side of the law

🌟 Premium: +10% money! 🌟
🌟 Riot City Studio group members: +10% money! 🌟
